d:
The story of Bihar’s GI-tagged Bhagalpuri Zardalu mango takes us to Bhagalpur, where we set out to understand what makes this delicate, aromatic mango such a prized variety.
We begin our journey in the local market, meeting a mango vendor to understand the demand for Zardalu, how the market works, when the mango arrives each season and how long it stays around. It is a glimpse into the journey of Zardalu from the orchard to the market, and what makes it so sought after.
